clause: Easing catalog: bezier presets + custom cubic-bezier + spring presets + custom spring [STU-PRO-019]

scope.summary: Implement the normative easing catalog shared between prototype transitions and the motion timeline (MT-391): bezier presets (Linear; Ease in/out/in-and-out; Ease in/out/in-and-out back with overshoot; Hold as a step), a custom cubic-bezier editor (two control points; out-of-[0,1] y produces overshoot), spring presets (Gentle/Quick/Bouncy/Slow), and a custom spring parameterized by stiffness, damping, mass. Easing/timing values MAY be stored as StudioVariables with modes so a mode switch updates every referencing animation. The easing editor is an operator surface.
expected_tests: argus: easing editor (bezier presets + custom bezier + spring presets + custom spring) reachable via author_id
live: custom cubic-bezier with out-of-range overshoot; four spring presets + custom spring (stiffness/damping/mass); easing storable as a StudioVariable
acceptance_criteria_original: shared easing catalog: bezier + custom bezier + spring presets + custom spring; variable-storable; author_id + manual entry

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-PRO-019] The easing catalog is normative and shared between prototype transitions and the motion timeline ([STU-PRO-030]). It comprises bezier presets, a custom cubic-bezier editor, spring presets, and a custom spring, enumerated below. Easing/timing values MAY be stored as `StudioVariable`s with modes so a mode switch updates every referencing animation ([STU-DS-028]). | Easing preset | Anchor | Kind | |---|---|---| | Linear | [STU-PRO-019a] | bezier | | Ease in / Ease out / Ease in-and-out | [STU-PRO-019b] | bezier | | Ease in back / out back / in-and-out back | [STU-PRO-019c] | bezier (overshoot) | | Hold (jump to final value) | [STU-PRO-019d] | step (timeline segments) | | Custom cubic-bezier | [STU-PRO-019e] | four-value / two-control-point editor; out-of-[0,1] y produces overshoot | | Spring: Gentle / Quick / Bouncy / Slow | [STU-PRO-019f] | physics preset | | Custom spring | [STU-PRO-019g] | parameterized by stiffness, damping, mass | ### 5. Overlays
| Ease in / Ease out / Ease in-and-out | [STU-PRO-019b] | bezier |
| Ease in back / out back / in-and-out back | [STU-PRO-019c] | bezier (overshoot) |
| Hold (jump to final value) | [STU-PRO-019d] | step (timeline segments) |
| Custom cubic-bezier | [STU-PRO-019e] | four-value / two-control-point editor; out-of-[0,1] y produces overshoot |
| Spring: Gentle / Quick / Bouncy / Slow | [STU-PRO-019f] | physics preset |
| Custom spring | [STU-PRO-019g] | parameterized by stiffness, damping, mass |

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
